fact: A Ministry of Finance communique of 10 April 2026 put the new ATOM registration application into service, replacing Harmony: new registrations on ATOM only from 1 July 2026 and Harmony-registered taxpayers to re-register by 31 December 2026.
title: MODERNISATION DU FICHIER DES CONTRIBUABLES : L'ADMINISTRATION FISCALE LANCE LA PLATEFORME « ATOM »
publisher: Ordre National des Experts-Comptables du Cameroun (ONECCA)
